commit_message: fix issue78 - now python-level teardown functions are now called even if the setup failed. Important detail: if the setup raises a Skipped exception, teardown will not be called.  This helps to avoid breaking setup_module/class that performs a skip - it would otherwise internally be considered as a "successful" setup in order to have teardown called later.
